plan.paradox: A penny gets you a whole music library. And you never see the bill.
plan.odd_fact: Members had to buy a minimum number of albums at regular club prices. Looks like a bonus.

plan.cause: The "minimum purchase" clause forces a recurring charge; if you don't decline, the next selection ships and you pay full price. Revenue hit $1.4 billion in 1996 then fell to $17 million by 2014.
plan.everyday: Gym membership: free week trial, then mandatory $30 class each month; coffee shop: free pastry, then automatic $12 refill subscription; streaming app: free movie, then $9.99 monthly bundle. The mandatory add-on makes the paid plan feel like a smart upgrade.
plan.rule: If something starts with a penny, check what you're locked into next. Follow for more.
